blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former President Rodrigo Duterte on Wednesday finally appeared before the International Criminal Court (ICC) Trial Chamber III for the third status conference of his crimes against humanity case. This marked the first time Duterte personally appeared before the ICC tribunal since he was arrested in March 2025. Dressed in a dark suit and white shirt with no tie, the former president sat with his chin resting on his hands as the proceedings opened.
